name: smwsprites-rideable-falling-leaf
title: Rideable Falling Leaf
description:
A kind of platform that can be ridden on by the player. The leaf falls and moves pretty identical to how SMW feathers do. Extra Byte 1 determines the initial horizontal direction (left or right). A generator is also included.
Both sprite and generator ASM files includes various configurable defines, like tilemap, moving speeds, acceleration, spawned leaves direction (generator), spawning rate (generator), and sprite to spawn (generator).

Daizo Update 16/04/2021: Now no longer moves when you flick the cape in close proximity with the sprite, preventing a bug seen here. Just update the cfg if you're already using the sprite.
